title: Rumors About Banda and the Opening of the Jali Din Campaign

blocks.text: A fresh round of rumor reshapes imperial confidence on this page. The court hears a rumor of Banda’s capture, or at least that he has lost the miraculous powers which had made him seem untouchable in earlier fighting.

Encouraged by that story, the emperor releases a coordinated campaign under Shamas Khan, Bajid Khan, and Jali Din. While Baj Singh remains associated with Lohgarh, the imperial side turns again toward plunder and revenue collection across the disturbed countryside.
The page opens the next military phase by showing how gossip becomes policy. Once the loss of miraculous powers is believed, commanders move as though Banda can now be contained by ordinary force.
